steps.title: Prepare Workspace and Instruments
steps.instruction: Sterilize the biosafety cabinet, pipettes, tip boxes, and other instruments using 70% EtOH, 10% Bleach, and 95% EtOH. Surface sterilize all instruments in the biosafety cabinet with UV light for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Leaf Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.15-0.3 grams of leaf tissue into new 2 mL screw cap microtubes (Thermo Scientific Catalog #3469NK). Weigh the tubes to verify the amount; samples between 0.3g and 0.6g can be split into two tubes.

substeps.instruction: Immediately cap and close tubes tightly after placing tissue to prevent DNA degradation at room temperature.
Store tubes in a -20 °C or -80 °C freezer until lyophilization.

steps.title: Lyophilize Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare the lyophilizer by turning on the refrigerator and placing the glass plate on the front, ensuring the chamber and drain tube are dry.

substeps.instruction: Once the refrigerator reaches -40 °C, turn on the vacuum pump (pressure must be below 150 milliTorr).
Release pressure by turning the white port 180 degrees to ensure a vacuum seal, then return to pressure.
Quickly transfer frozen tubes from the freezer to the lyophilizer chamber, close the lid and port.
Lyophilize samples for a minimum of 48 hours.
To remove samples: turn the white port 180 degrees to release pressure, wait for the gauge to read 0, turn off the vacuum pump and refrigerator, then remove the glass plate and wipe out melted water.

steps.title: Add Homogenization Beads
steps.instruction: In a sterile laminar flow hood, remove the parafilm or lid from the tubes and add the following beads:

substeps.instruction: Add 100 μL (2 beads) of autoclaved 3.2 mm stainless steel beads (Next Advance Catalog #SSB32).
Add 2-3 autoclaved 2 mm zirconium oxide beads using a sterile scoop (Next Advance Catalog #SSB14B).
Add 100 μL of autoclaved stainless steel bead blend (0.9-2.0mm) using a sterile scoop (Next Advance Catalog #ZROB20-RNA).
Secure lids tightly.

steps.title: Pulverize Tissue
steps.instruction: Pulverize the tissue into a fine powder using liquid nitrogen and a mechanical grinder.

substeps.instruction: Dip tubes/96-well plates in liquid nitrogen (ensure no cracks in plastic).
Clamp plates into shaker racks of a Geno Grinder 2010 or TissueLyser LT (Qiagen, 85600).
Shake at 1500 strokes/minute for 3 minutes (GenoGrinder 2010) or 25-30 Hz for 3 minutes (TissueLyser LT).
If tissue thaws, re-dip in liquid N2. Once ground to a fine powder, dip briefly in liquid nitrogen again to keep frozen.
Centrifuge the plate to move powder off lids: 4000 rpm for 1-3 minutes (96-well plate centrifuge) or 10,000 rpm for 1-3 minutes (Corning LSE centrifuge).
Store in -20 °C or -80 °C until DNA extraction.

steps.title: Lysis and Protein Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform initial lysis and protein precipitation in a sterile environment.

substeps.instruction: Surface sterilize workbench surfaces and instruments with 10% solution of 0.5% sodium hypochlorite, 70% EtOH, and 95% EtOH, followed by 30 minutes of UV light in the biosafety cabinet.
Add 700 µL of preheated Extraction Master Mix to each tube.

Shake vigorously by hand until tissue is thawed and suspended (use a hot water bath to assist thaw). If powder remains at the bottom, vortex for 5-30 seconds or use TissueLyser LT for 1 minute at 15 Hz.
Incubate for 20 minutes in a 60 °C water bath, gently inverting tubes ~10 times every 10 minutes.
Add 200 µL of 5M NaCl (Fisher Scientific Catalog #S271) or 5M Sodium/Potassium acetate and slowly pipette up and down or invert 25 times.

steps.title: Phase Separation and Purification
steps.instruction: Separate the aqueous phase from the organic phase using chloroform/isoamyl alcohol.

substeps.instruction: Add 900 µL of chloroform/isoamyl (24:1) to each tube.
Place in a nutating mixer (e.g., VWR 82007-202) for 10 minutes at 24 rpm, or invert by hand 20-40 times.
Centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4000 rpm (96-well centrifuge) or 10,000 rpm (Corning LSE).
Carefully pipette off 800-900 µL of the clear top aqueous layer using filter tips and transfer to new Eppendorf DNA low-bind microtubes (Fisher Scientific Catalog #022431048).
Repeat the chloroform extraction (steps 22-24 in original) to remove remaining RNase and contaminants.
After the second extraction, carefully pipette 700-800 µL of the top aqueous layer using wide-bore filter tips (created by cutting 3-4 mm off P1000 tips) into new low-bind tubes.

steps.title: SPRI Bead Purification
steps.instruction: Purify DNA using SPRI beads based on the volume of the recovered aqueous phase.

substeps.instruction: Pre-heat 10 mM Tris-HCl or 1X TE buffer to 50 °C in a heating block.

Prepare SPRI bead mixture (1.25% final concentration: 125 µL Sera-Mag Speed Beads, 2.5 g PEG-8000, 1000 µL 5M NaCl, 100 µL 1M Tris-HCl, 20 µL 0.5M EDTA, 5.5 mL 10% Polysorbate 20, and nuclease-free H2O to 10 mL).
Add SPRI beads to the sample at a ratio of 1.2 × DNA volume.
Incubate for 30 minutes in a nutating mixer at 24 rpm.
Spin down for 5 seconds in a centrifuge.
Place tubes on a magnetic rack for 5 minutes or until the solution is clear.
While on the rack, aspirate and discard the supernatant, leaving behind a few microliters if beads are drawn into the tip.

steps.title: Bead Washing and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the DNA-bound beads and elute the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Dispense 1 mL of fresh 80% ethanol to each tube, invert 25 times to resuspend the pellet, and flick tubes gently.
Spin down for 1-2 seconds, place on a magnetic rack, and aspirate out the ethanol.
Repeat the ethanol wash for a total of three washes.
Remove tubes from the magnetic rack and add 50 μL of elution buffer (10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0 or 1X TE buffer) pre-heated to 50 °C; pipette mix 5 times.
Incubate at 37 °C for 15 minutes in a benchtop shaking incubator at 20 rpm.
Spin down for 1-2 seconds.
Place tubes in a magnetic rack and let sit for 15-30 minutes.
Collect ~50 µL of the supernatant and transfer to a new tube.

steps.title: Final Storage
steps.instruction: Allow the DNA to homogenize and relax by letting the tube sit at room temperature overnight.

substeps.instruction: Store final DNA at -20 °C or -80 °C until quantification (Qubit or PicoGreen) and downstream analysis.
